footer.about: The 3D printing marketplace: buy, sell, create.

home.heroSub: 3D-printed objects from makers and workshops near you. Find, choose, receive.
home.noProducts: The first products are coming soon. Are you a maker? Open your shop.
home.sellTitle: Got a printer? Put it to work.
home.sellText: Open a free shop, list your products and get paid straight to your bank account.
home.how1d: Browse 3D-printed products from makers and workshops, filtered by material, colour and lead time.
home.how2d: Many pieces accept a name, text or variants: just type it on the product page.
home.how3d: The maker prints your piece and ships it with tracking. You pay securely by card.
home.sellB1: Open your shop for free: you only pay a commission ({pct}%) when you sell.
home.sellB2: Get paid straight to your bank account, with automatic payouts through Stripe.
home.sellB3: Your own storefront, indexed on Google, in Italian and English.
home.sellB4: Manage orders, shipping, refunds and statistics from one dashboard.
home.a1: By card, through Stripe. Payment is protected and the seller receives the amount net of the platform commission.
home.q2: How long does an order take?
home.a2: Every product page shows the production days and an estimated delivery. Shipping is tracked by the seller.
home.a3: Many products accept a text or a name: when it's possible, you'll find the field on the product page.
home.a4: From your account you can request a refund on the order. The seller reviews it and, if needed, our team.
home.q5: How do I sell my printed items?
home.a5: Open a free shop, complete payment verification and publish your first product. We guide you step by step.

legal.prohibitedIntro: The following may not be sold on 3D Market:
legal.p1: Weapons, firearm parts and items designed to cause harm.
legal.p2: Unauthorised copies of characters, logos, brands and protected designs.
legal.p3: Devices to bypass security or third-party access controls.
legal.p4: Safety-critical components (brakes, steering, medical devices) that are not certified.
legal.p5: Any item or content that is illegal under Italian and EU law.
legal.p6: Violations can be reported from any product page and are reviewed by our team.
legal.cookieBanner: We only use technical cookies required for the site to work (session and language).
